10500.description:
Here the slack water of Mira Retrum gathers itself and begins to run,
smooth and swift and glassy, sliding away east between low banks of
white sand toward the open ocean. The boat lurches as the current takes
it, and the hiss of moving water grows to a steady rush. South, beyond a
line of standing ripples, the calm sea lies drowsing in the sun.

10600.name: On the Ocean Shore

south.description: To the south lies On the Ocean Shore.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

up.description: To the up lies Down the Slope to a Shore.

10600.description:
A long boathouse of tarred timber stands on the shore here, built so
close under the bluff that its back wall is bare rock beaded with damp.
Its seaward end lies wide open, and a slipway of greased logs runs west
into the bright water of Mira Retrum, whose glitter throws rippling
light across the rafters. At the back, a steep stair of planks climbs up
through a hatch toward the slope and the plains above. Nets hang drying
overhead, and the shed runs on south past racks of long oars.

10601.name: On the Ocean Shore

north.description: To the north lies On the Ocean Shore.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10601.description:
The far end of the boathouse is given over to caulking and mending, and
a cold tar cauldron squats here on a hearth of blackened stones. A
second slipway runs west into the water of Mira Retrum, its logs worn
smooth and pale by many keels. Beside the open end, a weathered board
nailed to a post bears a long column of carved names. North, the shed
leads back past the oar racks to the foot of the stair.

extra_descs.board names post carved:
Each name is a boat that put out from this shed and never came home: the
Tern, the Good Margery, the Sister Ash and dozens more, cut by many
different hands over many years. Beside the newest, someone has pinned a
little wreath of dried sea-pinks.

10602.description:
Sheltered by the bluff, the water here lies so calm that the tarred
boathouse to the east is mirrored upside down in it, slipway and all.
Brown and golden weed sways on the stones below, combed out by the slow
pull of the tide. Across the open water to the west, Leper Island lifts
pale cliffs and dark jungle from the sea, and a thin thread of smoke
rises from its peak. The shallows run on south along the shore.

10603.name: On Mira Retrum

10603.description:
Your boat rocks in the shallows just off the boathouse, where the water
is so clear that every pebble on the bottom stands out sharp in bands of
wavering sunlight. East, a worn slipway climbs out of the sea into the
open end of the shed. Above its tarred roof the pale sandstone bluff
rises in ledges tufted with sea-pinks. The water runs north along the
shore and west toward Leper Island, glittering all the way.

10604.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies White Sand Beach.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10604.description:
Leper Island looms close here, a wall of pale, wave-gnawed cliffs
crowned with dark jungle. North, the sea runs straight into the mouth of
a vast sea cave, where a tongue of white sand gleams in the shadow
beneath the arch. The swell booms hollowly somewhere inside and sighs
out again with a cool breath of wet stone. Open water leads east toward
the mainland boathouse, south into the wide sea, and west along the foot
of the cliffs.

10605.name: On Mira Retrum

10605.description:
The cliffs of Leper Island rise sheer from the water beside the boat,
pale stone banded with grey and hung with vines that trail almost to the
sea. Waves suck and gurgle in a row of small caves along their foot, and
the air in their shadow is cool and smells of wet rock and green leaves.
East lies the great cave's mouth with its white beach, while the water
runs on west along the island and south into the open sea.

10606.name: On Mira Retrum

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10606.description:
Leper Island ends here in a ragged point of tumbled boulders, and a
stack of pale rock stands alone a stone's throw off it, its top streaked
white beneath an untidy crown of old nests. Past the point the sea opens
out, and the far shore of the plains shows as a long, low line of grassy
bluffs. The water runs east beneath the island's cliffs, west along the
plains' shore, and south into the deep.

10607.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

10607.description:
The shore of the plains bends close here, a low bluff of red earth
topped with waving grass, and a little beach of coarse sand lies at its
foot, strewn with weed. The coast curves so sharply that the ways north
and west both follow it to the same stretch of water. East, the rocky
point of Leper Island juts into the sea, and south lies open water.

10608.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10608.description:
The plains' shore wanders in and out here in a chain of little coves,
each with its own scrap of pale sand and its own fringe of rushes where
fresh water seeps from the bluff. Whether you steer north or west, the
winding coast leads on to the same cove ahead. The water is brown-green
and smells of wet earth, and the dry whirr of insects drifts down from
the grass. East and south lies the open sea.

10609.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10609.description:
A lone pine stands on the bluff above this stretch of shore, its crown
combed flat by the wind and leaning out over the water as if to see what
lies beyond the sea. Here the coast swings round in a long curve, so
that both the way north and the way west lead along it toward the next
headland. South, the black ribs of a wreck stand up from a sandbar;
east, the little coves wind back toward Leper Island.

10610.name: On Mira Retrum

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10610.description:
Long streaks of yellow pollen lie on the water here, blown out from the
flowering grass of the plains, and they swirl into lazy spirals wherever
an oar dips. The air carries the warm, dusty sweetness of hay over the
salt. The shore lies close by, a grassy bluff cut by a dry gully, while
the sea leads east toward the lone pine, west along the coast and south
into open water.

10611.name: On Mira Retrum

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10611.description:
The sea here is stained a clear tea-brown by fresh water spreading out
from the falls along the shore, and a sharp seam marks where it meets
the blue salt water. The surface carries the cool, earthy smell of a
stream. West, the white thread of the falls drops down the bluff; east
lie the pollen streaks, and south the sea opens toward an old buoy.

10612.name: On Mira Retrum

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10612.description:
A stream pours over the lip of the bluff here in a white ribbon of
falling water, crashing into a pool among the boulders at the sea's edge
with a steady, hollow roar. Spray drifts out over the boat in a cool,
rainbow-tinted mist, and ferns cling to the wet rock all around the
fall. The shore runs on east and west, and the open sea lies south.

10613.name: On Mira Retrum

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10613.description:
High on the bluff above this stretch of shore stands the stump of an old
watchtower, its stones the same rust-red as the cliff, its top broken
and its arrow slits staring out to sea. A rusted iron ring for mooring
boats is still set in a boulder at the water's edge. The falls roar
faintly to the east, while west the shore runs on and south lies the
open sea.

10614.name: On Mira Retrum

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10614.description:
Here the stumps of a drowned wood stand up out of the shallows by the
hundred, black and smooth as horn, some no higher than a knee and some
taller than a man. The sea moves among them with a soft, sucking sound,
and weed has wound itself around every one. It is said that this was dry
meadow and forest before the sea came in. The shore runs east and west,
and the open sea lies south.

10615.name: On Mira Retrum

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10615.description:
The bluffs above this stretch of shore are purple with wild thyme, and
the breeze carries its warm, sharp scent out over the water. Below them
the sea runs clear and pale over a floor of smooth pebbles, speckled
grey and green and rust. East, the drowned stumps crowd the shallows;
west the shore runs on toward rocky ledges, and south lies the open sea.

10616.name: On Mira Retrum

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10616.description:
Flat ledges of red sandstone run out from the foot of the bluff here,
and the swell washes over them and drains away, leaving a hundred tide
pools brimming and flashing in the sun. The rock is slick with green
weed and studded with limpet shells. The shore runs east and west, and
south a line of sunken stones leads out across the sea.

10617.name: On Mira Retrum

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10617.description:
A great arch of red sandstone stands out from the bluff into the sea
here, tall enough to sail a boat beneath, and the swell runs through it
with a hollow boom that echoes along the shore. Grass grows shaggy along
its crown, and long beards of weed drip from its underside. The shore
runs east toward the tide-pool ledges and west toward a ruined jetty,
and the open sea lies south.

10618.name: On Mira Retrum

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10618.description:
A jetty of tumbled stones runs out from the shore here, its far end
collapsed into the sea and its old mooring posts worn to stumps. On the
bluff above stand the roofless shells of a few stone cottages, their
doorways empty and their gardens gone to thistle. The shore runs east
toward a great arch and west toward lower ground, and the sea opens
south.

extra_descs.cottages shells ruins doorways:
The cottages were built of the same rust-red stone as the bluff and
roofed once with turf. Over the doorway of the largest someone has
carved a fish and a date too worn to read, and inside, a hearthstone is
still blackened by fires that went out long ago.

10619.name: On Mira Retrum

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10619.description:
Here the bluffs of the plains sink into low banks of yellow clay,
riddled with the round holes of burrows and slumping into the sea in
muddy fans. Clumps of rushes grow along the water's edge, the first of
the reed beds that fill the far end of the sea. East, the shore climbs
again toward the ruined jetty; west it bends into a broad, shallow
corner, and south lies open water.

10620.name: On Mira Retrum

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

10620.description:
The sea ends here in a wide, shallow corner, hemmed in by banks of clay
on one hand and endless reed beds on the other, and the water lies so
still and brown that the reeds stand doubled in it. A silence hangs over
the place, broken only by the dry rattle of stems. Open water leads back
east along the shore of the plains and south into the sea's lonely far
reaches.

10621.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10621.description:
Here the water runs over a shelf of brown rock just beneath the surface,
its weed streaming out like long hair in the slow current. Close at
hand, the mainland's sandstone bluffs rise in tiers of buff and rust,
and a thin fall of fresh water spills from a cleft to patter on the
rocks below. North, the cliffs of Leper Island hem in the sea; south and
west, the water opens wide and blue.

10622.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10622.description:
A breeze funnels between Leper Island and the mainland here, ruffling
the sea into dark patches that race across it like the shadows of
running cats. Every so often a short wave slaps the bow and flings a
cold spatter of spray into your face. The old fishing stakes stand in
their crooked rows to the south, the reef lies east, and open water
stretches north and west.

10623.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10623.description:
Out here the sea moves in a long, slow heave that lifts the boat and
lowers it again like a sleeper's breathing. Looking back, Leper Island
can be seen whole: a green hump of jungle rising to a bald grey cone,
from whose crest a feather of smoke leans with the wind. Open water
stretches every way, north toward the island's rocky point, east toward
the mainland, and south and west across the sea.

10624.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10624.description:
The wind dies away here, and the sea lies so flat and glassy that every
cloud floats upside down on its surface, until the boat seems to hang in
the middle of the sky. The only sounds are the drip from your oars and a
faint, far piping of birds. North, the grassy bluffs of the plains draw
nearer, while open water lies east, south and west.

10625.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10625.description:
The swell stirs fine white sand from the shallows here, and the water is
clouded to a strange milky green that hides the bottom completely. Now
and then an oar touches sand that you cannot see. West, the wreck's
black ribs rise from their sandbar; north, the coves of the plains'
shore lie close, and the sea opens east and south toward a tall marker
pole.

10626.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10626.description:
A long sandbar breaks the surface here, pale and ribbed by the waves,
and stranded on its crest lie the black ribs of an old ship, standing up
from the sand like the bones of some great beast. Weed and barnacles
crust the timbers, and the swell gurgles in and out among them. North, a
lone pine marks the shore of the plains, and open water lies east, south
and west.

extra_descs.wreck ribs ship timbers stern:
Enough of the stern survives to show that she was a broad, two-masted
trader, far bigger than any fishing boat. A name was once painted across
her transom, but the sea has scoured away all but the last few letters,
ALYON, as of some ship out of Port Halyon that came to grief a long way
from home.

10627.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10627.description:
Great shadows of cloud drift across the sea here, so that the water
darkens to slate and brightens to sapphire again as they pass over the
boat. Within each shadow the air turns suddenly cool. East, the black
ribs of the wreck stand up from their sandbar; north lies the pollen-
streaked water under the bluffs, and the sea runs on south and west.

10628.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10628.description:
An old barrel buoy, tarred black and bearded with weed, rides here on a
rusted chain, nodding and bowing with every swell as though in greeting.
Its iron hoops weep long red stains down the staves. South, a dark
skerry topped with a cairn stands up from the sea; the shore of the
plains lies north, and open water runs east and west.

10629.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10629.description:
Cold water wells up from the depths here in a broad, slowly turning
patch, smooth and dark green, and the air above it is suddenly chill
enough to raise gooseflesh. It smells of the deep and of old, cold
stone. North, the roar of the falls carries faintly across the water;
east bobs the barrel buoy, and the sea runs on south and west.

10630.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10630.description:
A fresh breeze off the plains whips the sea into short, bright waves
here, and their crests break into little white horses that run alongside
the boat and vanish. Spray stings your eyes and dries to salt on your
lips. North, a ruined tower stands on the bluffs; the cold green
upwelling lies east, and the sea runs south and west.

10631.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10631.description:
A dense bed of dark weed covers the bottom here, so that the water looks
as black as ink and the boat seems to float above a bottomless pit. Only
when the sun strikes straight down can you make out long fronds stirring
in the gloom. North, the drowned stumps stand in the shallows; south, a
great stone head rises from the sea, and the water runs on east and
west.

10632.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10632.description:
A knob of rock no bigger than a cottage roof breaks the surface here,
and on it the fishermen of the coast have built a tiny shrine of
driftwood and stone with a roof of shells. Faded ribbons flutter from
its eaves. West, a line of stones shows under the water like a sunken
road; north lies the shore of the plains, and open water runs east and
south.

10633.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10633.description:
A causeway of great fitted stones runs beneath the water here, so near
the surface that the boat seems to float down a drowned road, its paving
still straight and true and edged with kerbs. It runs from the shore of
the plains out toward the middle of the sea and is lost in the deeps.
East, the little shrine stands on its rock, and open water lies north,
south and west.

extra_descs.causeway stones road paving:
The paving stones are each as long as a bed and fitted so closely that a
knife blade would not slip between them. Deep ruts worn by wheels run
along the middle, and here and there a stone is carved with the same
sign, a crown above a wave.

10634.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10634.description:
The water is a thick, soupy green here, clouded by some bloom too fine
to see, and it leaves a faint, greasy sheen on the oars and a smell like
cut grass. The bottom is hidden entirely. East, the drowned causeway
runs on beneath the surface; north a great arch of red rock stands at
the shore, and the sea runs south toward a forest of kelp and west into
haze.

10635.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10635.description:
A haze lies over the western water here, and through it the far shore
plays tricks: low reed banks float above the horizon, doubled upside
down in the air, and the ruined cottages on the bluff seem to stretch
tall and thin. Close by, the sea is quiet and pale blue. North lies the
broken jetty, east the green bloom, south a little islet of white sand,
and west more haze.

10636.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10636.description:
Wisps of mist rise from the water here and drift like smoke, gathering
into a low, soft bank that hides the far shore and muffles every sound.
The air is cool and damp on your face, and moisture beads on the
gunwales. North the shore of the plains sinks lower, east the haze
shimmers over the water, and south and west the sea fades into the mist.

10637.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10637.description:
These are the loneliest reaches of Mira Retrum, where the water is a
dull pewter and the horizon is lost in haze. From somewhere to the west
comes a low and endless hiss, like wind in a field of barley, though the
air here is still. North lies a shallow corner among the reeds, east the
drifting mist, and south the sea runs on.

10638.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies Entering Quickstream.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10638.description:
East of here the calm of Mira Retrum breaks: the water begins to slide
and hurry, ruffled into lines of standing ripples, and a deep, rushing
murmur rises where Quickstream sets out for the ocean. The boat strains
toward it like a dog on a leash. North lies the still corner among the
reeds, south the swirling eddies, and west the last lonely reaches of
the sea.

10639.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10639.description:
A floating island of reeds, torn loose from the marshes by some storm,
turns slowly here, its matted roots trailing beneath it and its feathery
heads still nodding as if nothing had happened. The water is brown-green
and smells of marsh. North lies the reedy corner of the sea; east the
water begins to run toward Quickstream, and south and west the reed beds
close in.

10640.name: On Mira Retrum

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

10640.description:
This is the farthest corner of Mira Retrum, walled on two sides by reed
beds so tall and dense that nothing can be seen beyond them but sky. The
water is still and dark, flecked with fallen seed, and the loneliness
here is so deep that the slap of a wavelet makes you start. Open water
leads back east, and south the shallows run toward a mudflat.

10641.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10641.description:
Off the mainland's bluffs the bottom drops away abruptly, and the bright
green of the shallows gives way to a deep, cold blue. A loose raft of
yellow-brown weed lies spread on the surface here, buoyed by countless
berry-like bladders that glisten in the sun. North, the brown reef shows
as a dark stain under the water, while the sea rolls on south and west
in long, lazy swells.

10642.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10642.description:
A double row of old fishing stakes marches across the water here, grey
poles driven into the bottom long ago for a weir, most of them now
leaning or snapped off at the waterline. Weed hangs from them in green
beards, and their tops are whitened by roosting birds. Open water lies
all around: east toward the bluffs, south toward the turquoise shoal,
and north and west into the wider sea.

extra_descs.stakes weir poles:
The stakes were cut from black oak and pointed with axes, and a few
still hold the rotten wattle of the old weir between them. Fishermen say
the weir is older than the walls of Garathorm, and that no one has
emptied it since the night its builders rowed out and never came back.

10643.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10643.description:
The water here is clear as glass, and on the pale sand far below the
boat lies a huge iron anchor, its flukes furred with orange growth and a
length of rotten cable snaking from its ring. Ripples cast a moving net
of light across it, so that it almost seems to stir. The sea runs on
north toward Leper Island, east to the fishing stakes, and south and
west across open water.

extra_descs.anchor iron flukes ring:
The anchor is taller than a man and far too large for any boat that
sails Mira Retrum now. Letters were cast into its shank, but the growth
has crusted over all of them except the first, a squared, old-fashioned
G.

10644.name: On Mira Retrum

10644.description:
Beneath the boat the bottom is a garden of red weed and pale, branching
sea fans, all swaying together in the slow surge like poppies in a
summer wind. The sunlight reaching down to them is green and full of
drifting specks. East, the great anchor lies on its bed of sand; west, a
tall marker pole stands up out of the sea, and open water runs north and
south.

10645.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10645.description:
A tall pole of grey timber stands up out of the sea here, driven deep
into some hidden rock and braced with rusted iron bands. Its top is
carved into the shape of a leaping fish, and the paint still clinging to
it shows that it was once bright blue and gold. The water swirls past
its foot in small, busy eddies. Open sea lies on every side, with the
garden of red weed east and the milky shallows north.

extra_descs.pole fish carved marker:
The fish is carved with care, every scale cut separately and its mouth
open as if gasping. Fishermen of Mira Retrum set such poles over rocks
that lurk just under the surface, and they still touch an oar to this
one for luck as they pass.

10646.name: On Mira Retrum

10646.description:
Here the sea is deep, and looking down over the side you can watch
shafts of sunlight slant into the blue and draw together far below, like
the spokes of a great wheel meeting at a hub you cannot see. The surface
is quiet, broken only by the faint, rhythmic slap of water on the hull.
North, the wreck's ribs stand on their sandbar; the marker pole rises
east, and open water runs south and west.

10647.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10647.description:
The water shoals over a great bank of cockle shells here, millions of
them, white and pink and grey, so that the sea above has the pale gleam
of mother-of-pearl. When the swell draws back, the shells shift and
whisper against one another below the keel. West, a dark skerry topped
with a stone cairn rises from the sea, and open water lies north, east
and south.

10648.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10648.description:
A skerry of dark rock rises from the sea here, its flanks streaked white
and its crown topped by a squat cairn of piled stones. The sharp, fishy
reek of an old roost carries across the water, and the swell breaks
lazily over a shelf at the rock's foot. East lies the shell bank, and
open sea stretches north, south and west.

extra_descs.cairn skerry stones:
The cairn is built of flat stones set without mortar, and a hollow at
its heart holds coins gone green with age, a bent fishhook and a child's
carved wooden boat. Whoever leaves something here, the fishermen say,
will always find the way home across Mira Retrum.

10649.name: On Mira Retrum

10649.description:
Out in the middle of Mira Retrum the shores have sunk away into haze on
every side, and only the skerry and its cairn, a little way east, break
the endless shine of the water. The swell is slow and low, and the
silence is so deep that the creak of the boat seems loud. Open water
runs north, south and west, as empty as the sky.

10650.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

10650.description:
On the sandy bottom beneath the boat lies a small fishing skiff, settled
on her side and swathed in waving weed, her mast snapped and her oars
long gone. Paint still shows on her bow where a name was lettered, but
she lies too deep for it to be read. West, a great stone head rises from
the sea; south lies a rock awash in foam, and open water runs north and
east.

10651.name: On Mira Retrum

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

10651.description:
A colossal stone head rises from the sea here, crowned and bearded, the
head of some forgotten king whose body stands lost in the green depths
below. His face is worn almost smooth by wind and water, his eyes are
blind hollows, and weed hangs from his chin like a second beard of
green. Swells slap against his cheeks and fall back, and open sea runs
north, east, south and west.

extra_descs.head statue king crown stone:
The crown is a plain circlet set with square studs, and letters run
around it in a script no one on the coast can read. Sailors rub the
king's nose for luck when the sea is calm enough to come alongside, and
it has been worn bright and smooth by their hands.

10652.name: On Mira Retrum

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

10652.description:
Squared blocks of pale stone lie scattered on the bottom here, half
buried in sand, as if a wall or a tower had tumbled into the sea long
ago. Fishermen say that on still evenings a bell can be heard ringing
somewhere beneath the water, slow and muffled, from a town that was
drowned when the sea came in. East, the stone king gazes blindly out of
the waves, and the sea runs north, south and west.

10653.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10653.description:
Far off across the water, a cloud of white sea birds wheels and plunges
over a patch of broken, glittering sea, and their thin cries carry
faintly on the wind. Close at hand the water is calm, bottle-green and
empty. North, the drowned causeway runs beneath the surface; south lies
water of a startling blue, and the sea opens east and west.

10654.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

10654.description:
Tall stalks of kelp rise from the deep here and spread their golden-
brown fronds across the surface in a floating forest, which sways and
parts around the bow with a rubbery rustle. Looking down between them,
the stalks drop away like taut ropes into green twilight. East, the sea
runs calm and bottle-green, and open water lies north, south and west.

10655.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10655.description:
A tiny islet of white sand rises from the sea here, no bigger than a
threshing floor, with a tuft of grey salt-bush clinging to its crown and
a fringe of broken shells around its edge. The water around it is
turquoise and so clear that its sandy flanks can be traced far down. The
kelp forest lies east, and the sea runs north, south and west.

10656.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10656.description:
The bottom here is shaped into great ridges of sand, like dunes lying
under the water, each crested with a line of brighter ripples, and the
sea above them shades from pale to deep and back again as you pass. Bits
of shell roll slowly down their flanks with each surge. East rises the
islet of white sand, south the reeds come close, and the sea runs on
north and west.

10657.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

10657.description:
A faint, steady pull has crept into the sea here, and bits of weed and
foam drift past the boat all in the same direction, as though the water
itself had somewhere to be. The surface is streaked with long, wavering
lines where it slides. North and west the lonely water stretches into
haze; east lie the sunken sand ridges, and south the sea drifts toward
the reeds.

10658.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10658.description:
The sea is restless here, puckered into small, swirling eddies that spin
the boat gently about whenever you rest the oars. Long streamers of foam
are all drawn the same way, toward a hissing line of white water beyond
the haze. Reed beds edge the sea to the south, and open water lies
north, east and west.

10659.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10659.description:
A fowler's hide stands in the shallows here, a little hut of bound reeds
raised on stilts above the water, its door hanging open and its thatch
half blown away. The reeds rise thick and tall around it, rustling. East
the eddies swirl, south and west lie the reed-fringed shallows, and
north a channel of open water winds away among the beds.

10660.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

10660.description:
The sea runs out here in a broad flat of shining mud, studded with the
black stumps of old posts and threaded by little channels that wind away
into the reeds. The smell of mud and rotting stems hangs over
everything, and the water is barely deep enough to float the boat. North
and east lies water a little deeper; south, the shallows follow the
reeds toward a quiet bay.

10661.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10661.description:
Here the mainland's bluffs dwindle into a long slope of dunes tufted
with pale grass, and the sea's edge becomes a ribbon of white sand. The
water is a clear turquoise over a bottom of rippled sand, and so warm
that a faint haze shimmers above it. From somewhere south comes the
soft, endless boom of surf on the outer bar. Deeper water lies north
beneath the bluffs, and open sea west.

10662.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10662.description:
A broad shoal of white shell sand lies a few feet below the keel here,
and the water above it glows a vivid, almost unreal turquoise. Fragments
of shell glint on the bottom like scattered coins, and at the shoal's
edges the colour drops into deep blue as sharply as a line drawn with a
rule. The mainland dunes lie east, the white bar beyond the water south,
and the wider sea north and west.

10663.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10663.description:
The sun's glare lies on the water here in a broad, blinding road of
light, and it is hard to look anywhere but down into the shade beside
the hull. There the sea is a clean, deep green, threaded with drifting
motes of weed. The turquoise shoal glows to the east; south lies the
choppy water near the bar, and north and west the open sea rolls on.

10664.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10664.description:
A drift of grey pumice floats on the water here, hundreds of stones as
light as cork that knock against the hull with a dry, hollow clatter.
They must have come a long way, from some burning island far beyond the
bar, and their pocked faces are already furred with green. Otherwise the
sea is empty and blue: the glare lies east, the ocean swell rolls in
from the south, and open water runs north and west.

10665.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10665.description:
A long line of creamy foam wanders across the sea here, marking where
the water drawn in through the gap in the bar meets the slack water of
the inner sea. Feathers, seed husks and scraps of weed have gathered
along it like the tideline on a beach. North stands the carved marker
pole and east lies the pumice drift, while the sea runs on south toward
the bar and west into open water.

10666.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10666.description:
A great mat of floating weed lies spread across the sea here, so thick
and green that it looks like a meadow you could walk on, and the boat
pushes into it with a soft, dragging hiss. Air bladders pop under the
hull, and the smell of salt and rot hangs heavy. Clear water lies beyond
its ragged edges on every side, north and south, east and west.

10667.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10667.description:
A narrow band of short, steep wavelets runs across the sea here where
two slow drifts meet and jostle, and the boat jerks and twists as it
crosses, water chuckling loudly under the bow. On either side of the
band the surface lies smooth again. North lies the pale shell bank, east
the great mat of floating weed, and the sea runs on south and west.

10668.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10668.description:
Long, glassy slicks wind across the sea here like paths through a field,
smooth lanes the breeze cannot ruffle, while the water between them
shivers and sparkles. The boat seems to want to follow them. North, a
dark skerry stands up from the sea, and south lies the quiet driftwood
bay; to the west a faint smell of sulphur hangs over the water, and east
the sea runs on.

10669.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10669.description:
Strings of silver bubbles rise from the bottom here and burst on the
surface with soft little pops, and the water around the boat is as warm
as a bath and smells faintly of rotten eggs. Far below, a pale crust of
yellow and white rims the vents where the bubbles escape. The sea runs
north and east, south toward a quiet bay, and west toward a rock where
the swell breaks white.

10670.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10670.description:
A single black rock lies just awash here, and every swell that reaches
it breaks in a white, seething smother before draining away in a hundred
hissing rills. Boats give it a wide berth, and a few splintered planks
are wedged in a crack on its flank. East lies the warm, bubbling water;
south the sea drifts toward the quiet bay, and north and west it
stretches away open.

10671.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10671.description:
The water here is speckled with drifting seeds and sea-beans, smooth
brown and red and mottled, carried from shores no one in Garathorm has
ever seen. They gather in little rafts and spin slowly in the eddies
around the boat. North, the stone king's crowned head shows above the
water; east the swell breaks white on a lone rock, and the sea drifts
south toward the quiet bay and west toward a dead tree standing in the
water.

10672.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10672.description:
A whole dead tree stands upright in the sea here, drowned where it grew,
its grey trunk rising from the water and its bare branches spread
against the sky like the fingers of an open hand. The bark is long gone
and the wood is polished silver. To the west the water turns abruptly to
a deep, startling blue; north and east the sea runs open, and south it
drifts toward a quiet bay.

10673.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10673.description:
The sandy shallows end here at the rim of a great round hole in the sea
floor, and the water above it is a deep, startling blue, so dark at its
heart that it looks like a well sunk straight down into the night. A
chill rises from it. East stands the dead tree, drowned where it grew;
south the sea drifts toward a quiet bay, and north and west the shallows
run on.

extra_descs.hole blue well rim:
Peering down, you can see sand from the rim pouring over the edge in
slow, silent falls, and far below, ledges of white rock stepping down
into darkness. No fisherman will drop a line here, for they say that
what takes the hook is never what gets hauled up.

10674.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10674.description:
There is no shade anywhere out here, and the sun beats down on the water
until it glares like hot brass and the gunwales grow too warm to touch.
Salt dries in a white crust on everything the spray has wetted. East
lies the deep blue hole; to the south the drift runs toward the quiet
bay, and north and west the open sea shimmers away.

10675.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10675.description:
Just under the surface lies a great ring of piled stones, a fish trap
built by hands long gone to pen the fish when the tide fell. Weed has
knitted the stones together, and the water inside the ring is a shade
calmer than outside. North rises the little islet of white sand; east
lies open, glaring water, and the sea drifts south toward a quiet bay
and west toward the reeds.

10676.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

10676.description:
The reed beds of the far shore crowd close here, a whispering wall of
tall brown stems with feathery heads that nod and bow in every breeze.
The water is shallow and cloudy with fine silt, and the oars come up
streaked with mud. South, the sea drifts away along the reeds toward a
quiet bay, and open water lies north and east.

10677.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10677.description:
Shallow, sun-warmed water lies over a meadow of eelgrass here, its green
blades leaning one way and then the other as each small swell passes.
The smell of warm weed and salt hangs heavy in the still air, and the
mainland dunes shiver in the heat. South, a long bar of white sand shows
beyond the shallows, crested with dunes, while open sea lies north and
west.

10678.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10678.description:
Little swells come at the boat from two sides here, one rolling in off
the open sea and one rebounding from the bar, so that the water heaps
and slaps in a restless chop. The colour beneath you shifts from green
to blue and back as sandbanks and hollows pass under the keel. South
lies the sheltered water along the bar, east the warm eelgrass shallows,
and north and west the open sea.

10679.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10679.description:
From here the white bar is close enough to make out the wrack and
bleached driftwood along its inner beach, and above its dunes hangs a
haze of fine spray from the ocean surf beyond. The sound of that surf
comes as a low, unending thunder that you feel through the planks. The
water near the boat is quiet and smells of weed. South lies the channel
along the bar, with open water east, west and north.

10680.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10680.description:
The ocean swell that enters through the gap in the bar spreads out here
into broad, smooth undulations, so that the whole sea looks like rumpled
silk. The water is a deep, clean blue, and a cool breath rises off it
with the smell of the open ocean. South, the white cairn and its
figurehead mark the gap, and open water runs north, east and west.

10681.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10681.description:
The wind blows steadily across the bar here, lifting plumes of fine
white sand from the dune crests and sprinkling them over the water,
where they sink in glittering threads. The sea is a rich blue, ruffled
and lively. South, the bar opens toward the ocean; east and west the
inner sea runs along the dunes, and north lies open water.

10682.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10682.description:
A heat shimmer hangs over the bar here, so that its dunes seem to float
a hand's breadth above the sea, and the great whale's skeleton on the
sand to the south wavers like a reflection in a pool. The water is warm
and slack and smells of sun-baked weed. Small ripples lap at the hull
with a sleepy, steady sound, and open sea lies north, east and west.

10683.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10683.description:
The water is shallow and astonishingly clear here, and the boat's own
shadow glides over the white sand below, ringed with a halo of rippling
light. The sand is printed with the wandering trails of small things
that crawl by night. South, the bar lies low beside the water; west
opens a quiet bay, and the sea runs north and east.

10684.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

10684.description:
The slow drift of the whole inner sea seems to end in this quiet bay,
and its curving shore is heaped high with driftwood bleached silver by
the sun, whole trees among it with their roots in the air. The water is
calm and warm, littered with weed and floating husks, and the air smells
of sun-dried wood. North and east the open sea leads away, and south the
bay ends at a headland of black rock.

10685.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10685.description:
A long white bar of sand lies close alongside, its dunes crowned with
marram grass that hisses and bends in the wind. Beyond it, out of sight,
the Southern Ocean pounds the outer beach, and now and then a burst of
spray shows white above the crest. Inside the bar the water is still and
glassy, green over pale sand. The sheltered channel runs west along the
bar, and north lie the eelgrass shallows.

10686.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10686.description:
Inside the bar the water is a sheet of pale jade, so shallow that the
ripple marks on the bottom show clearly through it. On the bar itself a
single dead tree, grey and leafless, leans away from the ocean as though
it has been trying to walk off the sand for a hundred years. The calm
channel runs east and west along the bar, and deeper water lies north.

10687.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10687.description:
Here a hooked spit of white sand curls out from the bar, and behind it a
narrow tidal creek winds away among the dunes, its banks crusted with
salt. The water inside the hook is dead calm and as warm as a bath.
West, the bar is broken by a gap where ocean swells roll through; east,
the sheltered channel runs on along the sand, and north lies open water.

10688.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Ocean.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10688.description:
Here the white bar is broken by a wide gap, and through it the swells of
the Southern Ocean roll in long and green, lifting the boat high and
setting it gently down. On the tip of the bar stands a cairn of white
stones crowned with an old ship's figurehead, a carved woman gazing out
to sea. South, the gap leads out onto the Southern Ocean, while the
calmer water of Mira Retrum lies north, east and west.

extra_descs.figurehead cairn woman carved:
The figurehead is a woman carved in oak, her hair streaming back as if
in a gale and one hand pressed to her heart. Her paint has weathered to
a ghostly grey, but her eyes of blue glass still catch the light, and
fishermen touch their caps to her as they pass through the gap.

10689.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Ocean.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10689.description:
The ocean's breath is strong here at the gap in the bar, and the boat
rides up and down on swells that have travelled from beyond the edge of
any map. South, the gap opens wide onto the Southern Ocean, its water
dark and endless. East, the white cairn with its figurehead stands on
the tip of the bar, and west the bar runs on toward a great bleached
skeleton lying on the sand. Northward lie the quieter waters of the
inner sea.

10690.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10690.description:
The bleached skeleton of a great whale lies along the crest of the bar
here, its ribs arching over the sand like the beams of a roofless hall
and its skull half buried in a dune. Wind sings faintly through the
bones. Inside the bar the water is calm and green; east lies the gap
where the ocean swells come in, and west the bar runs on, low and white.
Open water lies north.

extra_descs.skeleton whale bones ribs skull jawbone:
Each rib is longer than a cart, scoured smooth and white by sand and
wind. Someone has cut a ring of small, careful marks into the great
jawbone, and the children of fishermen dare one another to sleep a night
beneath it.

10691.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies On Mira Retrum.

10691.description:
The bar is so low here that the ocean pours over it in storms, and broad
fans of white sand have spilled out into the inner sea, where the water
over them is barely deep enough to float the boat and glows a pale gold.
Driftwood and torn weed lie stranded along the crest. East, the whale's
great ribs arch over the sand, and west the bar runs on toward a dark
headland. North lies deeper water.

10692.name: On Mira Retrum

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies On Mira Retrum.

10692.description:
Here the white bar comes to an end against a low headland of black,
pitted rock, its ledges riddled with tide pools that flash like mirrors
when the sun strikes them. The swell surges among the rocks with a deep,
sucking gurgle. North lies a quiet bay heaped with silver driftwood, and
east the bar runs back toward the whale's bones.

10693.name: The Southern Ocean

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Ocean.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Ocean.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Ocean.

10693.description:
The swells here are long and heavy, and spray blows off their crests in
white streamers whenever the wind freshens. Looking back, the figurehead
on her cairn can just be seen guarding the gap in the bar to the north.
East, the ocean rolls on forever, swell after identical swell, while the
water runs south into deeper blue and west along the outside of the bar.

10694.name: The Southern Ocean

north.description: To the north lies On Mira Retrum.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Ocean.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Ocean.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Ocean.

10694.description:
Beyond the bar the sea changes entirely: the water turns a deep, cold
indigo, and the swells come marching in long ranks, each one lifting the
boat high enough to show the white line of Mira Retrum's beaches before
dropping it into a blue valley. North, the gap in the bar leads back to
calmer water. The ocean runs on east and south, and to the west it
stretches away unbroken, as though there were no end to it at all.

10695.name: The Southern Ocean

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Ocean.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Ocean.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Ocean.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Ocean.

10695.description:
Far from any shore now, the boat climbs each swell and slides down its
back into a trough so deep that for a moment only the sky can be seen.
The bar of Mira Retrum has dwindled behind to a thin white thread on the
horizon. East, the ocean stretches away without a mark on it, unchanging
however far you go; the swells run on south and west, and the way north
leads back toward the bar.

10696.name: The Southern Ocean

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Ocean.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Ocean.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Ocean.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Ocean.

10696.description:
Two sets of swells cross each other here, one from the ocean's far
reaches and one rebounding from some distant coast, heaping the water
into sudden, lurching peaks. Spray bursts over the bow without warning.
To the west the ocean runs on and on without change, as if it would
never end, while the way north leads back toward the bar and the swells
roll east and south.

10697.name: The Southern Ocean

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Ocean.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Ocean.

west.description: To the west lies The Southern Ocean.

10697.description:
Strands of torn kelp, thick as a man's wrist and longer than the boat,
roll in the troughs here, carried from some unknown coast. The air has
turned noticeably colder, and the swells come in heavy and slow, grey
along their backs. The ocean is so featureless that steering north or
east brings you back to the same stretch of rolling water, while to the
west the swells run on toward a colder sea.

10698.name: The Southern Ocean

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Ocean.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Ocean.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Ocean.

10698.description:
Nothing breaks the circle of the horizon here but the slow procession of
the swells, and the loneliness of the open ocean presses close around
the boat. A single long grey feather floats past on the water, turning
gently. The air is cold and clean, with a bite that speaks of ice not
far off; the ocean runs north and east, and south toward a colder
current.

10699.name: The Southern Ocean

north.description: To the north lies The Southern Ocean.

east.description: To the east lies The Southern Ocean.

south.description: To the south lies The Southern Mira Retrum.

west.description: To the west lies Lost in the Ocean.

10699.description:
A cold current sets in from the south here, and the water turns grey and
smells of snow, with a few small lumps of ice turning slowly in the
swell. South, that current runs on toward the Southern Mira Retrum,
where white bergs glimmer far off in the haze. To the west a bank of fog
lies on the sea like a wall of wet wool, swallowing the horizon, and the
open ocean rolls away north and east.

10700.name: Lost in the Ocean

north.description: To the north lies Lost in the Ocean.

east.description: To the east lies Lost in the Ocean.

south.description: To the south lies Lost in the Ocean.

west.description: To the west lies Lost in the Ocean.

up.description: To the up lies The Southern Ocean.

10700.description:
Fog closes in on every side, thick and white and dripping, until the bow
of the boat is the farthest thing you can see. North, south, east and
west look exactly alike, and every way you steer seems to bring you back
into the same grey murk. Only now and then a great swell heaves up out
of the fog, and riding up over its crest might carry you clear, back to
the open Southern Ocean.

10701.name: Lost in the Ocean

north.description: To the north lies Lost in the Ocean.

east.description: To the east lies Lost in the Ocean.

south.description: To the south lies Lost in the Ocean.

west.description: To the west lies Lost in the Ocean.

10701.description:
The fog is so thick here that it beads on your skin and drips from your
hair, and the water beneath the boat is black and utterly still. Sounds
die within a few feet: the creak of a plank, the splash of an oar.
Whether you turn north or south, east or west, the grey wall moves with
you, and there is no telling where the open ocean lies.

10702.name: Lost in the Ocean

north.description: To the north lies Lost in the Ocean.

east.description: To the east lies Lost in the Ocean.

south.description: To the south lies Lost in the Ocean.

west.description: To the west lies Lost in the Ocean.

10702.description:
A slow, silent eddy turns the boat in a lazy circle here, and the fog
swirls in its wake like smoke stirred by a hand. Once, far off, there
comes a hollow boom, as of surf on some unseen rock, but it does not
come again. North and south lead into the same blank greyness, and so do
east and west, with nothing to choose between them.

10703.name: Lost in the Ocean

north.description: To the north lies Lost in the Ocean.

east.description: To the east lies Lost in the Ocean.

south.description: To the south lies Lost in the Ocean.

west.description: To the west lies Lost in the Ocean.

10703.description:
Somewhere above the fog a pale smudge of light hangs where the sun must
be, but it seems to slide about the sky as the boat turns, and soon you
cannot be sure of it at all. Strands of drifting weed, the same strands
you have surely passed before, curl around the hull. The water runs
north and south, east and west into identical grey nothing.

106265.name: White Sand Beach

north.description: To the north lies White Sand Beach.

south.description: To the south lies Beach on Leper Island.

106265.description:
A high, narrow chamber rises over this patch of white sand, and a
natural chimney climbs up through the rock toward the cliff above, with
a glimmer of grey daylight far at its top. A ladder of rope and
driftwood rungs once hung down the shaft, but its lower half has rotted
away, and a fall of boulders now chokes the bottom. South lies the
hidden beach with its still green pool, and north the sand runs on into
a smaller recess.

106266.name: White Sand Beach

south.description: To the south lies White Sand Beach.

106266.description:
The cave ends in a small round grotto where the white sand slopes into a
pool of astonishing blue. The sea enters only from below, through a
drowned arch, and the daylight it carries makes the water glow as if lit
from within, throwing trembling blue reflections over the walls. Tiny
shells lie heaped in the hollows of the sand like spilled sugar. The
only way out is back south, beneath the chimney.

106267.name: Beach on Leper Island

north.description: To the north lies White Sand Beach.

east.description: To the east lies White Sand Beach.

106267.description:
This hidden beach lies in a broad, low chamber of the cave, its white
sand sloping to a still green pool that the sea feeds through some
drowned passage. In the middle of the sand stands a flat-topped stone,
worn smooth, with a weathered board propped against it. Niches have been
scraped into the walls at shoulder height, each blackened by the smoke
of old candles. North, the beach runs on beneath a dark chimney in the
rock, and east an arch leads back to the bend in the cave.

extra_descs.board stone flat weathered:
Words burned into the board with a hot iron have faded, but they can
still be read: LEAVE WHAT YOU BRING UPON THE STONE, FRIEND, AND GO IN
PEACE. WE WILL COME DOWN WHEN YOU ARE GONE. Beneath them, in smaller and
shakier letters, someone has added: BLESS YOU.

106271.name: White Sand Beach

north.description: To the north lies White Sand Beach.

south.description: To the south lies On Mira Retrum.

up.description: To the up lies Narrow Gully.

106271.description:
A beach of fine white sand slopes up out of the water inside a vast sea
cave, its arched roof alive with light thrown up off the waves. South,
the cave mouth frames a bright half-moon of open sea. At the back a
narrow gully climbs up into the island, but it is choked with thorn and
barred by a fence of lashed driftwood stakes. The beach runs on north
into the cool gloom of the cave.

extra_descs.fence stakes driftwood gully thorn:
The stakes are bleached driftwood lashed with tarred rope, their
sharpened points turned outward, and thorny brush has been packed
between them until nothing bigger than a lizard could pass. A strip of
red cloth knotted to the tallest stake has faded almost to pink, the old
sign of a sickness that must not be carried away.

106272.name: White Sand Beach

north.description: To the north lies White Sand Beach.

south.description: To the south lies White Sand Beach.

106272.description:
Deeper in the cave the sand is cool and firm, rippled by the tide into
long ridges that crunch underfoot. Far overhead, a crack in the roof
lets fall a single blade of daylight that strikes the beach like a
pillar of white fire, leaving the walls in blue dusk. Each surge of the
sea outside rolls in as a slow, hollow breath. The beach continues north
around a bend in the rock and south toward the bright mouth of the cave.

106273.name: White Sand Beach

south.description: To the south lies White Sand Beach.

west.description: To the west lies Beach on Leper Island.

106273.description:
Here the cave bends, and the white sand narrows to a strip between walls
of pale stone fluted by ages of waves. A crust of dried weed and broken
shells along one wall marks where storm tides reach, higher than a tall
man's head. West, a low arch opens into a second hidden stretch of
beach, lit by a faint green glow. South, the sand runs back toward the
cave mouth and the sound of the sea.

644800.name: gull grey-backed bird seabird
644800.long_desc: A grey-backed gull bobs on the swell here, eyeing you with a pale, greedy eye.
644800.description:
It is a big, heavy-bodied sea bird with a slate-grey back, a snowy
breast and a hooked yellow bill marked with a red spot near the tip. It
rides the water as easily as a cork, ready to snatch anything that looks
like food, including whatever you happen to be holding. Its harsh,
laughing cry carries a long way over the water.

644801.name: jellyfish jelly moon pale
644801.long_desc: A pale moon jellyfish pulses slowly just beneath the surface, trailing fine threads.
644801.description:
Its bell is as wide as a shield and clear as cloudy glass, with four
pale violet rings glowing at its heart like the reflection of a moon. A
fringe of fine threads hangs beneath it, almost invisible in the water,
and anything they brush comes away with a burning red welt. It drifts
wherever the swell carries it, opening and closing with a slow, patient
rhythm.

644802.name: crab sand pale
644802.long_desc: A sand crab scuttles sideways here, its claws raised and clicking.
644802.description:
Its shell is the colour of white sand speckled with grey, and on the
oldest of them it is as broad as a platter. Stalked black eyes swivel to
follow you, and its two claws, one much bigger than the other, open and
shut with a dry click. When frightened, it can bury itself in sand
faster than you can blink.

644803.name: seal grey playful
644803.long_desc: A playful grey seal pops its head out of the water, whiskers dripping, and watches you with great dark eyes.
644803.description:
It is a sleek, mottled grey beast as long as a man, with a round, dog-
like head, a bristling moustache of whiskers and huge dark eyes full of
mischief. It rolls and dives around the boat and surfaces on the other
side with a snort, as if it has played a fine joke. For all its play its
teeth are sharp, and in the water it is far stronger than you are.

644804.name: clam giant shell
644804.long_desc: A giant clam lies half-open on the bottom beneath the boat, its fluted lips rippling blue and green.
644804.description:
The clam is wider than a cartwheel, its two heavy, wavy-edged shells
crusted with weed and barnacles. Between them its mantle shimmers in
blues, greens and golds like a peacock's tail, and it snaps shut with
crushing force on anything that pokes inside. Divers on the coast dream
of the pearls such clams are said to keep.

644805.name: fisherman man sunburnt fisher
644805.long_desc: A sunburnt fisherman sits in a small tarred skiff here, paying out a line over the side.
644805.description:
He is a wiry, leathery man of middle years, burnt as brown as a
hazelnut, with salt crusted in his beard and a battered straw hat pulled
low against the glare. A great spiral conch hangs from a cord at his
shoulder for calling across the water when the mist comes down, and a
bundle of dried weed sits by his knee to chew on. He nods to you
politely, but his eyes never leave his line for long.

744800.name: pearl sea lustrous
744800.room_desc: A lustrous sea pearl lies here, glowing softly.
744800.description: A pearl as big as a hazelnut, perfectly round, with a soft, creamy lustre that shifts to pink and silver as it turns. Merchants in Garathorm pay well for pearls from the warm shallows of Mira Retrum.

744801.name: conch shell horn spiral
744801.room_desc: A great spiral conch shell lies here, its tip worn into a mouthpiece.
744801.description: A heavy spiral shell, cream outside and flushed a glossy pink within, its pointed tip ground away and smoothed into a mouthpiece. Blown hard, it sounds a deep, mournful note that carries for miles across the water, and fishermen use it to find one another in the mist.

744802.name: buckler crab shell shield
744802.room_desc: A small round buckler made from a crab's shell lies here.
744802.description: The broad, speckled carapace of an old sand crab, scraped clean and dried hard, with a leather grip laced through holes bored in its rim. It is light and a little brittle at the edges, but surprisingly good at turning a blow.

744803.name: seaweed dried weed bundle
744803.room_desc: A bundle of dried seaweed, tied with twine, lies here.
744803.description: Dark, crinkled strips of sea-wrack dried in the sun and tied with twine. It is salty and tough and takes a great deal of chewing, but it keeps for months and fills an empty belly on a long day at sea.
